x-behavior.credentials: none, except the one foreground Claude read below
x-behavior.network: none, except that read contacting Claude's existing usage endpoints
x-behavior.writes: one atomic consent/generation/receipt commit; deny revokes first and performs scoped Forget; the foreground Claude read may then write sanitized reader/Keychain state, never a secret

exitCodes.1: ok=false error; cleanup_pending may include a committed generation and pendingForget

x-behavior.idempotency: same request ID/body replays original response without another write or cleanup; older receipts may omit additive hostDetails
x-behavior.permission: receipt is not current permission; reread consent after mutation
x-behavior.keychain: A fresh Keychain grant starts one interactive credential operation; remote requests always obey the shared five-minute budget. No repeated operation on receipt replay.
